definition: who is in this house, and what having five of us ties me to

settled:
Five of us, and all five are autistic and ADHD both.

Me at forty, on Vyvanse. Jen at thirty-seven, my wife, who cooks at a professional level. Lizzy at seventeen, near the move to college. Joseph at fourteen, on Guanfacine. Katara at eleven.

Two of us are on a prescription, so a pharmacy and a prescriber are load-bearing for the household rather than for one person.

Five people tie us to this house. It is not one we could trade down out of easily.

They tie us to Provo as well. The schools and the friendships are the children's, so moving would be uprooting them rather than relocating me.
